boundaries.service: Three separate serial generated-document recipes per side, SQLite/LOCAL and real Router/Worker; ApplyCommand through Revision/CAS and DocumentView return. Each has 121 3D stages and121 sketches. Different document/Feature IDs between runs: recipe-level timing, not cross-document byte equality. Every run separately checks exact volume, old references, Undo/Redo, cold BREP/Naming SHA and preview does not move Head.
boundaries.baselineGoBuild: Frozen HEAD24b7e806 control/workspace/artifact sources plus additive unused generated Proto fields only; frozen baseline Worker. Baseline ran before development data reset.
boundaries.recordedRSS: ru_maxrss high water recorded by final addition, includes preceding process lifetime; not isolated operation allocation, live heap, steady-state memory or all later cold-read peaks.
boundaries.namingBytes: Old publication is the entire v2 file. Current publication is v3 root plus newly published block; reused prefix files are not included. Current root dependency closure is separately measured and is larger than a single old v2 file.
boundaries.queries: SelectionMS is three different anchors after modeling has populated views. ReopenedSelectionMS uses a fresh Service with empty parsed-root/block caches; its first lookup is cold, remaining lookups warm. No baseline reopened comparison was collected.
boundaries.statistics: Three serial samples are not P95, industrial capacity, GPU frame rate, original remote B-pillar or CATIA equivalence.
